hook: Krishna is an electrical engineer who joined IBM Research in 1990 and spent three decades inside the company before becoming its chief executive in April 2020. He was a principal architect of IBM's purchase of Red Hat, and as CEO he has put enterprise AI and hybrid cloud at the centre of the company's strategy, launching the watsonx platform in 2023 alongside IBM's open Granite models. IBM's results release of October 21, 2026 identifies him as chairman, president and chief executive officer.

timeline.event: Joins IBM at the Thomas J. Watson Research Center
timeline.impact: Begins a research career that runs for nearly two decades.

timeline.event: Earns a PhD in electrical engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
timeline.impact: Completes the doctoral training behind his research work at IBM.

timeline.event: Becomes senior vice president of IBM Research
timeline.impact: Takes charge of the company's research division.

timeline.event: IBM's acquisition of Red Hat closes in July
timeline.impact: Completes the $34 billion deal he helped design.

timeline.event: Elected CEO on January 30, effective April 6, succeeding Ginni Rometty
timeline.impact: Takes over the company and begins refocusing it on hybrid cloud and AI.

timeline.event: Becomes chairman of IBM's board effective January 1
timeline.impact: Combines board leadership with the chief executive role.

quick_facts: Holds an undergraduate degree from the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur and a PhD in electrical engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.
Joined IBM in 1990 at its Thomas J. Watson Research Center.
Was IBM's senior vice president for Cloud and Cognitive Software when the board elected him CEO in January 2020.
Became CEO on April 6, 2020, succeeding Ginni Rometty, and chairman effective January 1, 2021.
Is listed as IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer in the company's third-quarter results release of October 21, 2026.
Ranked No. 1 on CRN's 2021 Top 100 Executives list as its most influential executive.

achievements.title: Red Hat acquisition
achievements.impact: Served as a principal architect of IBM's $34 billion acquisition of Red Hat, which closed in July 2019.

achievements.title: watsonx platform
achievements.impact: Introduced at IBM's Think conference on May 9, 2023, with watsonx.ai for building and tuning models, watsonx.data for governed data, and watsonx.governance for overseeing AI workflows.

achievements.title: Granite models
achievements.impact: IBM's family of enterprise AI models, released under the Apache 2.0 open source licence and offered through watsonx.ai.

achievements.title: IBM Research leadership
achievements.impact: Led IBM Research as senior vice president from 2015, a period in which he pushed IBM into AI, cloud, quantum computing and blockchain.

source_basis: This profile was written mainly from the Wikipedia article on Arvind Krishna, retrieved 2026-10-22, with awards, dates and current role checked against IBM's CEO election release, its watsonx release, its Granite page, its October 21, 2026 results release filed with the SEC, and CRN.
